key_insight: AA-ViT synthesizes contrast-enhanced brain MRI from pre-contrast scans while better preserving anatomy and tumor boundaries than prior methods.
clinical_relevance: If validated further, this could reduce reliance on gadolinium contrast, lowering cost, scan time, and risk for patients who cannot receive contrast agents.
method: Uses a vision transformer with anatomical awareness.
Adds structural and frequency guidance to improve boundary and fine-detail preservation.
Trains on T1, T2, and FLAIR inputs from the BraTS 2021 dataset.
evidence_signal: In BraTS 2021 experiments, AA-ViT achieved higher PSNR and SSIM than state-of-the-art approaches, and 3 clinicians scored 19 cases with a mean rating of 3.94/5.
watch_item: The clinical evaluation was small and preliminary, so broader validation is needed before real-world use.
paper_title: AA-ViT: Anatomically Aware Vision Transformer with Structural and Frequency Guidance for Contrast Enhanced Brain MRI Synthesis
